summary: AIxCrypto Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K to report entry into a Consulting Agreement with Aibot US Operation Inc, a related party due to CEO Jerry Wang's minority ownership. Aibot will provide a four-person consulting team for finance, capital markets, and HR/legal support at a monthly fee of $50,000 plus reimbursed expenses capped at $500/month. The agreement, effective July 16, 2026, runs through July 15, 2027, with termination on 15 days' notice. Disinterested board and Audit Committee approved terms as fair. This is a routine service contract, not a special situation.
